title: Section 45 BNS — Abetment of a thing

content.heading: Abetment of a thing
content.text: A person abets the doing of a thing, who instigates any person to do that thing; or engages with one or more other person or persons in any conspiracy for the doing of that thing, if an act or illegal omission takes place in pursuance of that conspiracy, and in order to the doing of that thing; or intentionally aids, by any act or illegal omission, the doing of that thing. This is the successor of IPC 107.
